name: 滚动轴承额定寿命L10估算

map.🔮 滚动轴承额定寿命L10估算: 🔮 Rolling Bearing Rated Life L10 Estimation
map.基于 ISO 281 标准计算轴承基本额定寿命与修正额定寿命: Compute the basic and modified rating life of a bearing per the ISO 281 standard
map.📖 查看「滚动轴承额定寿命L10估算 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Rolling Bearing Rated Life L10 Estimation Guide"
map.💡 基本额定寿命 L₁₀=(C/P)^p（百万转）；寿命小时 L₁₀h=10⁶·: 💡 Basic rating life L₁₀=(C/P)^p (million revolutions); life in hours L₁₀h=10⁶·L₁₀/(60n). Modified life Lₙₐ=a₁·a₂·a₃·L₁₀.
map.注：a₂ 为材料系数（普通淬火钢取1.0，真空脱气钢取1.5~3.0）: Note: a₂ is the material factor (1.0 for ordinary hardened steel, 1.5-3.0 for vacuum-degassed steel)
map.📚 深度解析：轴承寿命反求载荷: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Bearing Life and Back-Calculated Load
map.给定目标寿命 Lh、转速 n、尺寸 d·B，反求所需额定动载荷 C。: Given the target life Lh, speed n and dimensions d·B, back-calculate the required dynamic load rating C.
map.校核平均压强 p=F/(d·B) 与 pV 值。: Check the mean pressure p=F/(d·B) and the pV value.
map.比较不同寿命要求下的 C。: Compare C under different life requirements.
map.球轴承寿命指数 p=3，C/P=(L10)^(1/3)；滚子轴承 p=10/3。: The ball bearing life exponent p=3, so C/P=(L10)^(1/3); for roller bearings p=10/3. This example assumes a ball bearing.
map.p=F/(d·B) 是投影比压，滑动轴承还需乘速度得 pV 控制发热。: p=F/(d·B) is the projected contact pressure; for plain bearings it is further multiplied by the speed to give pV, which controls heat generation.
